description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different language models across various evaluation metrics. The horizontal axis represents the evaluation metrics, which include PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The vertical axis indicates the performance score, ranging from 0.42 to 1.00. The bars are color-coded to represent different models: RedWhale (our) is shown in purple, EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in light blue, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) in dark blue. The RedWhale model consistently outperforms the other two models across all metrics, with scores ranging from 0.46 to 0.69. The EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 model shows moderate performance, with scores between 0.56 and 0.74. The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model has the lowest scores, ranging from 0.42 to 0.61. The chart does not include any annotations or visual emphasis on specific bars.
